Package com.csse3200.game.components.cards

Class CardWidgetAssets

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.cards.CardWidgetAssets
public final class CardWidgetAssets extends Object
Shared visual dependencies for CardWidget.

The widget deliberately receives these assets instead of loading or disposing textures. This keeps texture ownership in the screen's ResourceService and lets read-only and interactive card consumers reuse one presentation component.
